ng data with NMSE 1.0e-23, well under the 1e-12 target.

I found it by noticing that dA_dt·A was about 2.58 at small t and grew with both t and A. A fit of dA_dt·A = c + k·A^p·t^q then gave p = 1 and q = 3 exactly. That reduces to the form above.

The rate is positive, so A increases over time here.
